page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-64 is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4d server family. It is equipped with 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and 504.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 7.88 GB per core. This configuration provides a dense memory allocation relative to compute resources, making it suitable for workloads that require substantial memory capacity.

This server type does not include local NVMe SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance contains zero GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or direct GPU-based machine learning workloads. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

The c4d-highmem-64 offers a high-density memory profile on dedicated CPU resources, which is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of GPU hardware. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
